selection: Chosen for genuine multichannel measurements, public fixed splits and manageable lengths before inspecting test performance.
training: 5 stratified folds on original training set only; fold seed 93400+dataset index; all normalization fitted within fold
normalization: per-channel training mean and SD; tanh((x-mu)/(3*sd))
time: 0.1 s per sample; piecewise constant model interpolation
tie: strongest ridge penalty among identical mean CV balanced accuracies
scope: model-decision preservation; external-label accuracy evaluated separately
